events.verdict: Olynyk (MIA) absorbs the contact from Temple (MEM) during his driving shot attempt.
Mack (MEM) reaches in and makes contact with Olynyk's (MIA) arm that affects his SQBR and control of the ball.
Mack (MEM) cleanly dislodges the ball from Olynyk (MIA) in the lane.
Jones Jr. (MIA) trips Mack (MEM) as both players attempt to get to the loose ball.
Conley (MEM) initially has his arms extended, but collapses them and does not deliver the contact to Adebayo (MIA) on the screen.
Green (MEM) absorbs the contact from Johnson (MIA) during the pick.
Jones Jr. (MIA) makes contact with Green's (MEM) arm and affects his putback dunk attempt.
Richardson (MIA) briefly clamps Green's (MEM) arm, but does not affect his ability to defend.
Green (MEM) maintains a legal guarding position defending Richardson (MIA).
Jones Jr. (MIA) makes marginal contact to Green's (MEM) foot when it is extended backwards on his driving shot attempt.
Johnson (MIA) makes clean contact to the loose ball.
Adebayo (MIA) makes a clean block during Mack's (MEM) shot attempt near the rim.
Temple (MEM) places two hands on Richardson (MIA) and slides them off without affecting his SQBR during the inbound.
Adebayo (MIA) makes high-five contact with Conley's (MEM) hand after he has released the ball.
Green (MEM) commits a take foul on Jones Jr. (MIA).
Both Gasol (MEM) and Green (MEM) make marginal contact with Adebayo (MIA), who loses his balance and steps out of bounds.
Conley (MEM) does not kick-out unnaturally into Jones Jr. (MIA) on his driving shot attempt.
Jones Jr. (MIA) makes marginal contact with Conley's (MEM) body and does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Temple (MEM) commits a take foul on Olynyk (MIA).
Mack (MEM) draws Johnson (MIA) into the air towards him and he makes body contact during Mack's upward shooting motion.
Green (MEM) dislodges Olynyk (MIA) during the release of the free throw shot.
Adebayo (MIA) makes high-five contact with Gasol's (MEM) hand after he has released the ball.
